scope: Initialization and exact-control checks only; no training claim
program_source:
"""Check initial score dispersion and exact controls before the QKNorm follow-up screen."""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import torch

from lab.dsl import AttentionDiagnostics, describe, swap
from lab.infrastructure.benchmarks import build_task
from lab.infrastructure.engine.attention import AttentionObserver
from lab.infrastructure.nn import build_model

ROOT = Path('/tmp/transformer-qknorm-study')
ORIGINAL = Path('/home/misha/lean_projects/transformer')
ARMS = ('softmax', 'qknorm-one', 'scaleddot', 'learned-dot-one', 'learned-dot-matched')


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def tensor_sha(value):
    return sha(value.detach().contiguous().cpu().numpy().tobytes())


torch.set_num_threads(1)
old = runpy.run_path(str(ORIGINAL / 'experiments/basis_sparsemax/experiment.py'))['experiments']
new = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'experiments/basis_qknorm/experiment.py'))['experiments']
assert len(new) == 150
description_checks = {}
for label, run in new.items():
    for arm in ('softmax', 'qknorm-one', 'scaleddot'):
        prefix = arm + '-'
        if not label.startswith(prefix):
            continue
        suffix = label.removeprefix(prefix)
        original_label = 'softmax-' + suffix if arm == 'softmax' else 'repair-' + arm + '-' + suffix
        source = old[original_label]
        expected = swap(source, 'diagnostics', AttentionDiagnostics(every=source.evaluate.every, examples=256))
        assert describe(run) == describe(expected), label
        description_checks[label] = {
            'original_label': original_label,
            'description_sha256': sha(json.dumps(describe(run), sort_keys=True).encode()),
        }
assert len(description_checks) == 90
initial, summaries, gradient_checks = [], {}, []
for size in ('small', 'large'):
    head_rows = {arm: [] for arm in ARMS}
    for seed in (0, 1, 2):
        images, models, batches, tasks = {}, {}, {}, {}
        fingerprint = None
        for arm in ARMS:
            label = f'{arm}-hard-{size}-recall-seed{seed}'
            run = new[label]
            task = build_task(run.benchmark, run.seeds.data, torch.device('cpu'))
            model = build_model(run.model, task.vocab, run.seeds.model)
            observer = AttentionObserver(run.diagnostics, task)
            before = {name: tensor_sha(value) for name, value in model.state_dict().items()}
            modes = [module.training for module in model.modules()]
            rng = torch.get_rng_state().clone()
            batch = observer.fixed.batch.clone()
            row = observer.observe(model, task, 0)
            assert before == {name: tensor_sha(value) for name, value in model.state_dict().items()}
            assert modes == [module.training for module in model.modules()]
            assert torch.equal(rng, torch.get_rng_state())
            assert torch.equal(batch, observer.fixed.batch)
            assert all(parameter.grad is None for parameter in model.parameters())
            fingerprint = row['rows_sha256'] if fingerprint is None else fingerprint
            assert fingerprint == row['rows_sha256']
            images[arm] = {name: digest for name, digest in before.items() if not name.endswith('log_alpha')}
            assert images[arm] == images['softmax']
            models[arm], batches[arm], tasks[arm] = model, observer.fixed.batch, task
            heads = row['layers']['blocks.0.attention']['actual']['supervised_rows']
            head_rows[arm].extend(heads)
            initial.append({'label': label, 'description': describe(run), 'non_gain_state_sha256': images[arm],
                            'observer_state_preserved': True, 'observation': row})
        outputs = []
        for arm in ('scaleddot', 'learned-dot-one'):
            output, targets = tasks[arm].forward(models[arm], batches[arm])
            loss = tasks[arm].loss(output, targets)
            loss.backward()
            outputs.append(output.detach())
        assert torch.equal(*outputs)
        gradients = [{name: tensor_sha(value.grad) for name, value in models[arm].named_parameters()
                      if not name.endswith('log_alpha')} for arm in ('scaleddot', 'learned-dot-one')]
        assert gradients[0] == gradients[1]
        gain_gradients = {name: value.grad.detach().tolist() for name, value in models['learned-dot-one'].named_parameters()
                          if name.endswith('log_alpha')}
        assert any(any(value != 0 for value in values) for values in gain_gradients.values())
        gradient_checks.append({'size': size, 'seed': seed, 'exact_logits': True,
                                'exact_non_gain_gradients': True, 'gain_gradients': gain_gradients})
    summaries[size] = {arm: {key: sum(head[key] for head in heads) / len(heads)
                             for key in ('mean_score_std', 'mean_support_positions', 'mean_support_share',
                                         'exact_zero_pair_share', 'singleton_row_share')}
                       for arm, heads in head_rows.items()}
    print(json.dumps({'size': size, 'initial_first_layer_query_means': summaries[size]}), flush=True)

program = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
raw_path = ROOT / 'experiments/basis_qknorm/runs/preparation/observations.jsonl'
raw_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with raw_path.open('w') as raw:
    for record in initial:
        raw.write(json.dumps({'label': record['label'], 'observation': record['observation']}, separators=(',', ':')) + '\n')
        record['observation'].pop('queries')
        for layer in record['observation']['layers'].values():
            layer.pop('answer_routes')
            layer.pop('shadow_answer_routes')
artifact = {'checked_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'scope': 'Initialization and exact-control checks only; no training claim',
            'program_source': program.decode(), 'program_sha256': sha(program),
            'experiment_sha256': sha((ROOT / 'experiments/basis_qknorm/experiment.py').read_bytes()),
            'original_experiment_sha256': sha((ORIGINAL / 'experiments/basis_sparsemax/experiment.py').read_bytes()),
            'lab_source_sha256': {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(path.read_bytes())
                                  for path in sorted((ROOT / 'python/src/lab').rglob('*.py'))},
            'control_description_checks': description_checks, 'gradient_checks': gradient_checks,
            'initial_first_layer_query_means': summaries, 'initial': initial,
            'raw_initial_observations': {'path': str(raw_path.relative_to(ROOT / 'experiments/basis_qknorm')),
                                         'sha256': sha(raw_path.read_bytes()), 'rows': len(initial)}}
destination = ROOT / 'experiments/basis_qknorm/preparation.json'
destination.write_text(json.dumps(artifact, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'initial_models': len(initial), 'identical_control_descriptions': len(description_checks),
                  'actual_shape_gradient_pairs': len(gradient_checks), 'artifact': str(destination)}), flush=True)
